text: Lorenzo's daughter Chiara graduates from Bologna on June 3rd. He's flying out the day before with his wife. Remind me to send a card to Chiara before then.
Demi lives in Leeds now, just off the ring road. She works for the council in planning and has two boys, both at secondary school.
Owen had his knee operation on Tuesday. He sounded groggy but fine when I rang. Should text him at the weekend to see how the physio is going.
Jen's son Ethan starts reception on September 4th. She's more nervous than he is, apparently.

Zainab mentioned her dad is having a hip replacement on 2 November 2026 at St James's. He's been on the waiting list for nearly two years, so it's a relief, but he's terrified of anaesthetic. She's taking the week off to look after him, and her brother Obi is covering the following week. Remind me to message Zainab on the 2nd to see how it went.
Need to pick up my prescription before Friday and book the dentist for some time in March 2027.
Met Mei's partner Hugo for the first time. He's a structural engineer and they rent a flat in Clapham with a very fat cat called Biscuit.
Ciara's GCSE results come out on 8/20. Don't forget to message her that morning.
Nora is back home after three nights in hospital with her appendix. Her sister Olga is staying with her until she can drive again. I should drop round some soup this week.
Obi's graduation got cancelled because of the strike, so the university is doing a ceremony online instead on May 14. Ask him if he wants us to watch it together.
Yetunde Adeyemi works at the children's hospital as a play specialist. Originally from Ibadan, moved here in 2015. Two daughters.
Zara passed her driving test this morning on her third go! Mum's taking her out for dinner tonight to celebrate.
Lwazi said his little girl lost her first tooth and the tooth fairy has been very generous. He also mentioned she starts swimming lessons on October 12th.
Nadia is having a scan on 11/3 and she's quite anxious about it after last time. Remind me to call her the evening after.
Quick one: Saanvi's mum is coming over from Pune for Diwali and staying until mid-December.
Asha is training to be a midwife and is on placement at the Royal until the end of January. She lives with her brother Reza in Hackney.

Lukas called to say his shoulder surgery has been moved from 9 December to January 14th because the surgeon is off sick. He's frustrated because he'd already arranged cover at work and his mum had booked trains down to help. Now he has to sort it all again, and he's in a lot of pain most nights. Must check in with him around Christmas, and maybe offer to drive him to the hospital on the day.
Olivia's twins finished primary school today. Big assembly, lots of crying, mostly from Olivia.
Reggie lives on the same street as my sister, number 42, the house with the blue door. He's retired now but used to drive buses.
Theo is waiting on his A-level results and keeps saying he's failed everything. Results day is August 13. I should text him good luck the night before, and then remember to ask him how it went.
Darius and Noor are taking the kids to Disneyland Paris over Easter, leaving April 2nd and back on the 9th.
Gintaras had a mild heart attack last month and is now doing cardiac rehab twice a week. He looks thinner but in good spirits. His wife says he's finally given up smoking.
Isaac's son got into Edinburgh to study medicine. Isaac couldn't stop smiling. Send them both a congratulations card.
Ximena works remotely for a design studio in Barcelona and spends winters in Mexico City with her family.

Lunch with Alejandro today. He's moved to Bristol, still at the same bank but working from home three days a week. His partner Demi is pregnant with their first, due in early March 2027, and she's had awful morning sickness which has only just eased off. He's already thinking of names and has a spreadsheet, of course. They're doing the nursery up over Christmas. Need to get something for the baby before then.
Chiara's PhD viva was on 10/7. Never heard how it went. Must ask her when I see her on Saturday.
Booked my own eye test for 23 November 2026, 9:40 at Specsavers. Bring old glasses.

Demi's mum has been in and out of hospital since the summer with her lungs. Demi is exhausted, going up to Newcastle every other weekend. She didn't want to talk about it much, so I didn't push. Her husband Lukas is holding the fort with the boys. Remind me to call her next week, and maybe offer to have the boys for a Saturday so she gets a break.
Owen is a primary school teacher in Reading. Year 2. Loves it.
Mei said her nephew Theo starts nursery on Monday and she's worried he won't settle because he's never been away from his mum.
Hugo's dog Pickle had an operation on his leg yesterday and has to wear the cone for two weeks. Hugo is sleeping on the sofa next to him.
Called Zainab back. Her dad's operation went well and he was up walking by the evening. Still in for a few more days.

Jen's eldest, Olivia, has her first ballet exam on June 21st. Jen says she's been practising in the kitchen every night and has worn a hole in her tights already. Olivia is seven now and wants to be a dancer when she grows up, apparently. Their youngest, Theo, starts nursery the week after, so it's a big month for them. Ask Jen how the exam went afterwards.
Lorenzo mentioned his brother Reggie is moving to Canada in spring 2027 for work. Their mum is not pleased.
Need to remember to buy wrapping paper and a birthday card for the office tomorrow.
Noor's daughter starts secondary school on September 3rd and Noor still hasn't sorted the uniform. Her husband is away for work that whole week.

Spoke to Asha about her grandad on the phone. He fell in the garden last week, broke his wrist, and is now in a cast for six weeks. She says he's being very stubborn about letting anyone help, insists on doing his own shopping. He's 88 and lives on his own in Leicester since her nan died. Asha is going up most weekends but she's worn out.
Nora's son Isaac graduates from Leeds on 7/16. She's been hinting that a nice frame for the graduation photo would be the perfect present.
Ethan and his wife have split up. The vow renewal they were planning for May is off. He's staying at his brother's for now. I should take him for a pint soon.
Olga is a nurse on the orthopaedic ward at the General. She's lived in this country since 2008 and her daughter is at uni in Glasgow.
Reza had his wisdom teeth out this morning. Face like a hamster, apparently. Remind me to send him a funny get well message tonight.
Gym at 7, then the big shop. Haven't got anything planned for Sunday.

Ciara Brennan from work says her son Owen is sitting his eleven-plus on September 13th. He's so nervous he's not sleeping and has been getting stomach aches before school. She's trying not to put any pressure on him, and his dad is taking him to the test so she doesn't make it worse. She asked me to keep it quiet. Results come out in mid-October.
Saanvi Kim is a dentist, practice on the high street, lives in Didsbury with her husband and their two kids. Allergic to nuts.
Darius has a consultant appointment on 5/14 about his back. He's hoping they'll finally book him in for surgery. Don't forget to ring him on the 15th to find out what they said.
Lwazi's wife Yetunde gave birth on Thursday! Little boy, 7lb 2oz, called Isaac. Both doing well. Should order flowers.
Theo Moreau is the new neighbour at number 9. Moved in from Lyon with his partner and a greyhound called Pepper. Works in IT.

Had coffee with Ximena this afternoon. Her daughter Zara has her university interview at Cambridge on December 8th for natural sciences and has been revising nonstop since half term. Ximena is more stressed than Zara, if anything, and keeps checking the train times. Her husband is driving them up the night before so they don't have to rush. Text Zara good luck the day before, and ask Ximena how it went once they're home.

Alejandro finished chemo last Friday! The video of him ringing the bell was lovely, the whole ward clapping. He says the tiredness is the worst part now, and he's still not allowed back to work until the new year. His next scan is in February 2027, which he's trying not to think about. He's going to Spain with his sister Nadia in March to celebrate, their first trip together since they were kids.
Nadia's little one, Lukas, took his first steps on Saturday. She sent a video of him wobbling towards the dog.
Remind me to ask Obi how his mum's cataract surgery went. It was meant to be last Wednesday.
Jen and her husband are hosting a party for their son Hugo's graduation on June 28th. Barbecue in the garden from 2. I'm bringing a salad.
Mei works in a lab at Imperial, something to do with proteins. Her parents live in Singapore and she visits every Christmas.

Noor's dad is in hospital again with pneumonia, the second time this year. She's going straight there after work every day and hardly sleeping. Her brother Darius flies in from Dubai on Thursday to help, and her aunt is coming down at the weekend. Noor said the doctors are hopeful but it's slow going. I should send her a message tomorrow and offer to do a school run or two.
The school called: Lorenzo's son's prize-giving on 3 December 2026 is cancelled because of the building works. They might reschedule in the new year.
Isaac and Reggie are doing a sponsored walk for the hospice on May 9th in memory of their dad. I should sponsor them both.
Zara's cat Mochi turns one on Friday. She's making it a tiny cake. Very Zara.

Olivia is recovering from a C-section, so she's not driving until at least 11/28. Her partner Gintaras is working from home to help. I need to pop round with a meal next week, maybe Wednesday or Thursday.
Yetunde has a job interview on Monday for a senior role at the children's hospital. Fingers crossed for her.
Chiara mentioned she lives with her grandmother in Turin while she studies. Her grandmother makes the best tiramisu she's ever had.
